**Description**

The issue was originally only on the SPIR-V backend (#3735), but while fixing it for SPIR-V, noticed DXIL is now also broken.

**Steps to Reproduce**

https://godbolt.org/z/T9c5Tdnsf

```hlsl
struct ControlPoint {
  float4 position[100] : POSITION;
};

struct HullPatchOut {
    float edge [3] : SV_TessFactor;
    float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;
};

HullPatchOut HullConst () {
  return (HullPatchOut)0;
}

[domain("tri")]
[partitioning("fractional_odd")]
[outputtopology("triangle_cw")]
[patchconstantfunc("HullConst")]
[outputcontrolpoints(3)]
ControlPoint Hull(InputPatch<ControlPoint, 1> v,
                  uint id : SV_OutputControlPointID) {
  ControlPoint p;
  return p;
}
```

**Actual Behavior**

```
UNREACHABLE executed at DirectXShaderCompiler/lib/HLSL/HLSignatureLower.cpp:523!
Aborted
```

comments.body:
So, we should probably generate a better error for this. That said, I'm pretty sure this issue isn't solvable without a shader model change.

@tex3d is probably the best authority here, but my read of this is that we're hitting a limit of an 8-bit field in the PSV0 data. We can (and probably should) handle this error better, but supporting this shader likely needs a shader model change.
I don't think you need to support the shader. The original reporter seemed happy with the error message. However, we should avoid the crash.

It appears that some legitimate error cases that we detected later in the compilation pipeline were converted to `llvm_unreachable`.  This is the cause of the crash.  This is a legitimate error from the shader (packed elements must fit in 32 rows of 4-component vectors), but it isn't detected until we attempt to allocate the signature elements, which we can only do after we have flattened the signature structure and identified these elements.

See the following change, which turned this error into `llvm_unreachable`:
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/commit/21e56159eadc740c7ee6d01dbb6ec3251a769226#diff-9406e37b16c71f4146d9c673b5e6dc8408024b2411bdd3212095df9c375d7907L502-L503
